info.name: Keeweb
info.summary: Open and edit KeePass KDBX 3 and KDBX 4 password vaults
info.description:
Open, search, create, and edit encrypted KeePass password databases (.kdbx) directly inside Nextcloud.
Features: - Full client-side encryption and decryption in your browser powered by kdbxweb (zero-knowledge server storage) - Native support for both KDBX 3.1 (AES-KDF) and KDBX 4.0 / 4.1 (Argon2d and Argon2id, AES-256 and ChaCha20) - Unlock vaults with a master password, a key file (local upload or selected from Nextcloud Files), or both - Group hierarchy browser, instant search, masked passwords with copy actions, custom fields, and built-in TOTP codes - Create, edit, and delete entries and groups, plus create new KDBX 4.1 or KDBX 3.1 vaults directly in Nextcloud - Atomic saving with ETag concurrency verification to prevent overwriting concurrent edits, and automatic read-only mode on shared read-only files - Direct click integration in Nextcloud Files for Nextcloud 28 through 35
